An aggressive beast with a headbutt and a committed charge. Bait its charge into an obstacle to stun it.

## Health and poise

| Level | Variant | Easy / Builder health | Normal health | Hard / Hardcore health | Poise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Charger | 115 | 126.5 | 149.5 | 65 |
| 2 | Charger | 166.75 | 183.43 | 216.78 | 65 |
| 3 | Elder Charger | 218.5 | 240.35 | 284.05 | 65 |

These are non-elite values before omens. Poise does not scale with creature level or difficulty. In the outer lands (Birchwood, the Mire, the Highlands, Elderwood and the coast) creatures have **×1.3 health**, **×1.15 poise** and **×1.2 damage**, notice heroes from 15% further, move 5% faster and are 60% more often elites; packs of Stalkers and spiders there hold one more. Base movement speed: **3.6 m/s**, before night, state, omen and elite modifiers.

## Attacks

| Attack | Base damage | Normal, level 1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Headbutt | 16 | 17.92 |
| Charge | 24 | 26.88 |

Damage = base × (1 + 0.3 × (level − 1)) × difficulty multiplier. Easy/Builder: ×1; Normal: ×1.12; Hard/Hardcore: ×1.35. This is outgoing hit damage before the hero’s armour, mitigation and other combat effects. Venom and grave rot are separate status effects.

## Elite and warden modifiers

Elite health is multiplied by 1.6, poise by 1.3 and outgoing damage by 1.15. Ironhide adds ×1.8 health and ×1.6 poise; Frenzied adds ×1.35 damage; Swift adds ×1.3 movement speed. Barrow wardens also apply their own health multiplier, ×1.6 poise and ×1.2 damage. These effects stack.

Elite loot is **additional** to the normal drops: one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/charger-trophy/"><img src="/images/icons/chargertrophy.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Charger Trophy</a>, two <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/hide/"><img src="/images/icons/hide.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Raw Hide</a>, plus one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/crystal/"><img src="/images/icons/crystal.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Echo Crystal</a> with 65% / 80% / 95% chance at level 1 / 2 / 3. The game uses the Stalker trophy for elite spiders too. Omens can add further drops.
